hashAlgorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify with object keys recursively sorted by JavaScript default string sort and array order preserved; no whitespace or trailing newline.
baselineNormalization: Remove only inventory fields live and format. Preserve the original question source object. sourceFile is reconstructed from current catalog ownership after the six explicit voice mappings.
calibrationRevisionScope: Current questionCalibrationRevision helper applied to the current question. No claim about the revision from a previous deployment.

interpretation.reviewStatus: Copied from each ledger. Verified and fixed apply only within correctAnswerCheck.scope and its limits. Soundcheck and Echo audio listening remain unverified.
interpretation.sourceOnly: Question JSON changed only under the top-level source field.
interpretation.playerVisible: At least one data change affects a prompt, category, answer, scored result, clue, image/audio contract, card, or reveal. Source/audit metadata, IDs, patch labels, variety keys and seed difficulty are excluded.
interpretation.metadataOnly: Data changed, but neither a player-visible data field nor only source changed.
interpretation.unchanged: Canonical question JSON is unchanged. A ledger may still mark a code-only behavior correction as fixed.
interpretation.coverage: This index covers stored question content. Changes to UI/server code and unavailable live-client or listening checks are not counted as question-data changes.
